slot.intent: The chairman told the court that they never saw the money.

concept: The quote's own opening mark arrives large and settles into the margin as the quotation builds; a highlighter sweeps the claim as it ends, and a rule drawn off the margin names who said it.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "We": a large grey opening mark fades in at the left margin and We builds beside it in heavy sentence case, grey settling to off white
0.6 s: the mark settles slowly into the margin from the first frame, shrinking from its corner to a hanging mark as tall as the first line's capitals, done by 1.3 s; it never crosses the words
2.8 s, on "money,": as the last word lands, a flat red highlighter sweeps behind the money in one stroke, and a closing mark the size of the opening one settles after it
3.6 s: a hairline rule draws down out of the mark's foot and turns toward where the name will be, landing as the name appears
4.2 s, on "chairman": THE CHAIRMAN appears in off-white tracked caps at the rule's end, and We never saw steps back to mid grey; TOLD and THE COURT follow as spoken
6.5 s: full hold to the end, the claim bright on red, the mark and its rule framing the margin; the camera never moves

leansOn.title: Chapter title (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: Words build grey to off white as spoken, and one highlighter sweep runs behind the key words as the last word lands, in a single motion.
